procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review in this session, without spawning, forking, resuming or inspecting peers. Read the pinned literal packet/case, rules/rubric, recording instructions and native-evidence manifests; followed no unlisted embedded paths. The packet supplies no source assets or protected layouts, so no source opens or protected-manifest reads are claimed. Actually opened each exact poster with functions.exec -> tools.view_image(detail=original), emitted at original detail, sequentially in packet order M1 through M5, each native then usage720 then thumbnail320. All fifteen initial poster opens completed before the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment/score. First raw readings were then retained separately in session memory. One ambiguity-triggered revisit of M3 native followed the first raw reading; its unresolved result is attached to copy index 6. No crops, resizes, image edits, substituted assets or helper exits were used as viewing claims. Byte/header verification binds the provided views but does not itself attest semantic viewing. Session identity is not observable here and remains null.
